legacyConfigFailed: Legacy config could not be imported
saveCopyAndReset: Save a copy, then reset to defaults
prefsMigratedFrom: Migrated once from {from}; the old file is kept as is and no longer read.
presetSketchHint: Dot-grid paper, handwriting, pencil frames, highlighter headings and marker quotes
fontChineseHint: Chinese glyphs; Latin text follows this unless a Western font is set
fontWesternHint: Latin letters and digits; follows the Chinese font by default
fontCodeHint: JetBrains Mono by default; independent of the layout theme
tabCountSummary: {count, number} in total; up to {max, number}, keep at least 1
tabTitleMaxWidthHint: 80–220 DIP; longer text gets an ellipsis, unnamed tabs show only a dot
tabAnimSpeedHint: The pace of the liquid merge animation
tabMotionHint: Off switches tabs instantly, without the liquid merge animation

glassStrengthHint: Opacity of the translucent layer on platforms without system material (20–90%)
tabsPageFootnote: Tab text, names and colors belong to the notes data and save with it; window material is a platform capability and falls back to a translucent color when missing.
mirrorUnconfiguredHint: Each backup is mirrored to an external folder: a cloud-sync folder means cloud backup, a Git clone can auto-commit. Skip to keep local backups only.
autoBackupIntervalHint: 1–1440 minutes; a throttle interval, not an independent timer
backupKeepHint: 1–1000; shrinking prunes at the next successful backup, not immediately
backupOnLaunchHint: Backs up once at launch when a data file already exists
gitModeOffDetail: Each backup writes a copy; git add and commits stay off.
gitModeCommitDetail: After each backup write, git add zakki-*.json and commit; failures only notify and never affect the backup itself.
gitModeCommitPushDetail: Like commit, and pushes as well; failures only notify and never affect the backup itself.
dialogChooseMirrorMessage: Choose a cloud-sync folder (iCloud, Nutstore, …) or a local Git clone; every backup is mirrored there.
saveFailedQuitCancelled: Save failed; quit or update-restart cancelled: {err}
noticeRecoveredFromBackup: Data file was corrupt; recovered from backup {name} (original quarantined)
noticeWriteProtected: Data file is corrupt with no usable backup; new edits are staged in .pending — use “Write Back Data File” in the menu to confirm overwriting
onboardChooseBackupBody: Every backup is additionally mirrored to this folder. A default location is preselected — just continue, or click Change to pick another spot.
onboardTabCountBody: How many tabs on first launch (1–{max, number}); add or remove anytime in Settings.
onboardFirstMirrorErr: Data saved, but the first external backup failed: {err}
onboardDraftPendingNotice: First-run data was not saved; the setup wizard may show again next launch
onboardLanguageSub: You can change it anytime in Settings.
welcomeIntro: {n} colorful tabs for quick notes. This is **Tab 1**.

modeRowHint: Light / dark / follow the system; applies immediately
writeProtectedBody: The data file is corrupt with no usable backup; new edits are staged in .pending and the original is quarantined. Writing back needs your confirmation.
gitDetailOff: Off; each backup only writes a copy into the folder.
gitDetailNotRepo: The folder is not a Git repository, so Git automation is unavailable; it works fine as a cloud-sync folder.
gitDetailPickFirst: Pick a backup folder first; Git automation needs a Git repository.
welcomeBodyTips:
- [ ] Try checking me: other blocks re-type instantly; click any block to edit
- ⌃1–⌃9 switch tabs; ⌘T new tab; Enter splits blocks, arrows cross them
- ⌘F searches this tab, ⌘⇧P toggles source mode
- ⌘B / ⌘I / ⌘K bold, italic, link; ⌘⌥1–6 set headings
- ⌘⇧Space shows/hides the window globally by default (rebind in Settings → Shortcuts)
- Themes and backup options live in Settings… ⌘, and apply immediately
- Tab names, order and colors are in Settings → Tabs; double-click the capsule to rename
- ⌥⌘T keeps the window on top; Esc hides it
welcomeBodyFooter:
Supports **bold**, *italic*, `code`, [links](https://github.com/egoist/mygo), quotes and code blocks.

> Built with [MyGo](https://github.com/egoist/mygo).
ctxInline: Acts on the selection or the caret; works inside table cells
accBareLetter: Bare letters/digits cannot be a shortcut; add ⌘/⌃/⌥
mirrorNotGitErr: The backup folder is not a Git repository; Git automation cannot be enabled
mirrorStatePending: not mirrored yet (written on next backup)
prefsVersionAheadHint: the preferences file version may be newer than this app

prefsSaveBlockedPending: Preferences await recovery; nothing is written until confirmed
mirrorErrLocalBackup: The local backup folder (or its subfolders) cannot be the external backup destination
mirrorErrAppData: The app data directory cannot be the external backup destination
prefsBackupCopyErr: Failed to save a copy of the original
ctxParagraphContext: Used in paragraph context; unavailable inside table cells
